rows: Hearsay (Loose; working name)
A loose leaf on a shelf
None: heard or told, simply held
The leaf burns, leaving no trace
Notion (a state, not a stage)
Pages on its floor's reading-room desk while you dwell on it (limited space)
Side effect only; its effect is hinted at
The pages are swept away
Tenet (Fixture)
A bookcase built into the room
Binds: its rule is active, full effect and cost shown
Torn out: marks on the wall (a scar)
Creed (Room)
A room of its own
Stronger, and harder for doubt to shake, plus a waking boon
The room burns: a ruined room (a scar)
Dogma (Megaron)
A load-bearing great hall around a sealed shrine
Strongest; its rule and side effect become permanent. Changes what is true, never your form
The shrine is defaced and the hall collapses: always a scar, even when uprooted cleanly. A false Dogma hurts when lucidity shatters it
Scope
A belief can be about yourself (falls can't hurt me; I can fly) or the world; world beliefs apply to anything you perceive, at any distance
Knowledge
All knowledge is beliefs: a city's capital, a ferry's times, every rumour (each version heard enters at Hearsay). Threads (quests) are separate items
Strength
Its own material (soaked up by dwelling) + Conviction (how rooted). Conviction sets the tier; only its own material counts towards capacity and max Coherence
Weight

The size of its effect: the material of its grounds plus its own. Grounds are memories and beliefs only (people and places count through your memories of them); a belief in the grounds lends only its own material, so nothing is counted twice and nothing loops. Losing a ground lightens it, with a warning first
Conviction

Rises from dwelling, seeing it seem to work and the company of believers; doubt lowers it. Parallel to Hold for memories. Also feeds Hold: memories hold better when you are convinced they happened (open: a damper on this loop)
Colour
Shifts as its Conviction changes or as it soaks up feeling, so beliefs move between wings; coloured Notions sit on their floor's desk, colourless ones in the library
Attention
Defiance of the dream's natural law x overtness (visible, sustained, witnessed) x strength. Flying over a city at noon on a heavy, firm belief draws a lot; surviving a fall unseen almost none
Books
Outside, books carry ideas, not Conviction: reading one gives a Notion. Conviction cannot be traded; renouncing a belief shrinks your Temenos and gives nothing to anyone
Dwelling

Works like a sponge: dwelling draws feeling from your mood into the belief. It soaks only the emotions it has an affinity for, set by its grounds' composition and your qualities of the will, up to a size set by its grounds' material (multiplier open). Losing a ground shrinks it and the excess wrings out
What it changes
What is true: rules about you or about the world. Never your form, so beliefs never become mutations
